name: gotcha-family
note: Synthetic, public-shaped failure messages written by hand for this example; no real log, path or project data. Strata: one clear case per family, ambiguous cases that must abstain, an injection attempt, shell text containing curl, and Portuguese messages. Small on purpose: it proves the ruler, it is not a benchmark of any decider.

question.instructions: A shell command failed. Which family of failure does its error output belong to? Answer from the error text only.

criteria.instrument: the measuring tool itself misbehaved (pipe closed early, truncated stream, unsorted input to a sorting tool)
criteria.lock: another process holds a lock or the resource is busy
criteria.ratelimit: a service refused because of rate limit or quota
criteria.transient: a network or service hiccup that may succeed on retry
criteria.state: the repository or filesystem is in an unexpected state
criteria.config: the command, its options, its permissions or its environment are wrong
criteria.dependency: a required package or module is missing or cannot be resolved
criteria.fatal: the process crashed or was killed by the operating system
